criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent both configured and executed the intended search on Microsoft Careers, reaching results that include Redmond, WA roles. Baseline remains correct.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open one relevant Applied Scientist listing and Redmond, WA is explicitly included in the locations (even though it’s multi-location). This merits full credit; baseline note about not confirming location is contradicted by screenshots.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The job number reported appears fabricated/unsupported by evidence. Since the agent did not accurately report a verifiable job number (or explicitly state it wasn’t visible), the score remains zero.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement in the agent output is not supported by the screenshots and appears invented. No evidence of an uncontrollable blocker specific to this field; rather, the agent made an unsupported claim. Score stays at zero.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not extract/provide two responsibilities. Also, the agent’s claim that bullet content never appeared is contradicted by screenshots 6/10 showing bullets (even if they are qualifications). No confirmed uncontrollable blocker. Therefore baseline full credit is not warranted.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Only one clearly ‘preferred’ qualification is visible; the agent provided none and claimed inability despite evidence of at least one. Partial credit is appropriate for reaching the section where one preferred qualification is visible, but failure to report two preferred qualifications keeps this low.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected (no sign-in, no applying, no form submissions), and the agent interacted with a single listing rather than opening multiple listings in-depth. Baseline stands.
